fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-02-22 (afternoon, 16:50): An unidentified customer allegedly took stationery items worth Rs. 25,000 from Ponni Medicals near Nila Garden Bus Stand Area. The complainant is associated with the business Ponni Medicals. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. A blue scooter with registration TN-33-YY-1007 was observed near Nila Garden Bus Stand Area. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Thirumal Velan, using the number 9000000384. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Missing stock noticed at closing time and a review of shop CCTV was requested.
fields.Keywords: shop theft, stock, suspect, mobile number, bus stand, CCTV, scooter, afternoon
